title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Intellectual Property Court

articles.content_en:
Article 1: The Supreme People's Court shall establish an Intellectual Property Court, which shall primarily hear intellectual property appeal cases involving strong technical expertise, such as patent cases.
The Intellectual Property Court is a permanent adjudication organ dispatched by the Supreme People's Court and located in Beijing.
The judgments, rulings, mediation agreements, and decisions rendered by the Intellectual Property Court are the judgments, rulings, mediation agreements, and decisions of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 3: The lower people's courts that try the cases referred to in Article 2 of these Provisions shall, as prescribed, promptly transfer the paper and electronic case files to the Intellectual Property Court.

Article 4: The Intellectual Property Court may require the parties to disclose information on related cases such as ownership, infringement, authorization, and confirmation of rights in respect of the intellectual property involved in the case. If a party refuses to make a truthful disclosure, this may be taken as a factor in determining whether the party has followed the principle of good faith and whether it constitutes abuse of rights.
Article 5: The Intellectual Property Court may, according to the circumstances of the case, conduct circuit trials at the actual site or at the location of the original people's court.
Article 6: The Intellectual Property Court shall handle preservation and other measures in accordance with the relevant provisions on enforcement procedures.

Article 7: The case filing information, composition of the collegial panel, trial process, and adjudication documents of cases heard by the Intellectual Property Court shall be disclosed to the public according to law.

Article 8: The judges' meeting of the Intellectual Property Court shall be composed of the chief judge, deputy chief judges, and a number of senior judges, and shall discuss major, difficult, and complex cases.

Article 9: The Intellectual Property Court shall strengthen research and investigation into the adjudication work of relevant cases, promptly summarize adjudication standards and trial rules, and guide the adjudication work of lower people's courts.

Article 10: With respect to the judgments, rulings, and mediation agreements that have become legally effective in first-instance civil and administrative cases of the types specified in Article 2, paragraph 1 of these Provisions, rendered by an intellectual property court or an intermediate people's court, if a provincial-level People's Procuratorate files a protest with a Higher People's Court, the Higher People's Court shall notify the procuratorate that the protest shall be filed with the Supreme People's Court by the Supreme People's Procuratorate according to law, and the case shall be tried by the Intellectual Property Court.

Article 11: These Provisions shall come into force on January 1, 2019. Where any judicial interpretation previously issued by the Supreme People's Court is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
